trigger: Wait for automatic job bg_743 delivery. Do not poll process, stdout, stderr, artifact existence or launch-receipt paths for progress.

permitted_after_delivery.metadata_only: Read the launcher receipt; bind the actual manifest/input/prompt/schema hashes, child PID, native /bin/date start and finish, Popen.wait exit status, byte lengths and SHA-256 of artifacts. Parse raw JSON only mechanically to extract top-level event type/subtype, init model, result subtype/is_error, modelUsage keys, duration/num_turns and presence or absence of structured_output. Count bytes/events or tool-call metadata if needed; never display any assistant content, result text, structured_output contents, theorem/finding/severity/claims or any mathematical payload.
permitted_after_delivery.correspondence: Verify the observed output paths, sizes and hashes agree with the receipt and the manifest, and record every discrepancy. Actual observed model identity, not requested model, governs the process report. An absent init model or final result identity is reported as missing, not guessed.

if_timeout_or_failure: Preserve the raw artifacts that exist and exact job/tool failure. A wrapper timeout or process disappearance does not establish a child exit. Do not rerun, kill a process, contact an author, send further CLI prompts, read a quarantined payload or infer scientific correctness from exit status.
math_disposition: NO_MATHEMATICAL_DISPOSITION_ADMITTED. The return remains entirely HELD/ZERO/NONINPUT for math-4 and every clearance or adoption consumer, independent of its provider success/failure. This gate supplies no new review route and does not rehabilitate any held material.
publication_and_cost: No push, commit, publication, deletion, credential handling or additional provider/model invocation is authorized by this gate.
limits: All current source, selected-method, recipient, cross-slot, L1, w45, w58, w110/w111, scientific HOLDv2, N4 UNKNOWN and auxiliary214 restrictions persist. Deadline remains 2026-10-31T21:23:27Z.
